career_ladder.note: SSC Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) and Havaldar recruits foundational General Central Service Group 'C' non-gazetted, non-ministerial personnel across central government ministries, attached offices, Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC), and Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN). Employees can advance into clerical and executive streams through departmental promotional exams.

exam_scheme.note: SSC MTS Examination is conducted as a single-tier Computer Based Examination divided into two compulsory sessions. Session I (Maths & Reasoning, 120 marks, 45 minutes) has NO negative marking and is qualifying in nature. Session II (General Awareness & English Language, 150 marks, 45 minutes) determines the final merit ranking, with 1 mark deducted per wrong answer. For Havaldar posts, candidates must additionally qualify a Physical Efficiency Test (PET: 1600m walking in 15 min for male, 1 km in 20 min for female) and Physical Standard Test (PST).

competition_benchmarks.note: SSC MTS is among India's most competitive 10th-standard public recruitment drives, attracting 30-40 lakh registered applicants annually. The 2024 notification announced 9,583 vacancies (MTS: 6,144, Havaldar: 3,439). Previous cycles filled 1,773 posts in 2023 and 12,523 posts in 2022.
